candidates.exact_span: The limit for viable helminth ova is less than one per four grams of total solids (dry weight basis) either before or following pathogen treatment.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes a numeric pathogen limit and two alternative timing scopes (before vs. following treatment); different readings of when sampling applies would change which measurements are compared to the limit and whether monitoring was required at a given event.

candidates.exact_span: Alternative 4 - The density of enteric viruses in the sewage sludge shall be less than one Plaque- forming Unit per four grams of total solids (dry weight basis) at the time the sewage sludge is used or disposed or at the time the sludge is prepared for sale or give away in a bag or other container for application to the land.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Specifies a numeric enteric-virus limit and multiple trigger times (use/disposal vs. bagged preparation for sale/giveaway); interpreting which trigger applies to a facility event changes the applicable limit comparison and the monitoring episode obligation.

candidates.exact_span: The density of viable helminth ova in the sewage sludge shall be less than one per four grams of total solids (dry weigh t basis) at the time the sewage sludge is used or dispose d or at the time the sewage sludge is prepared for sale or give away in a bag or other container for application to the land.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets a numeric helminth-ova limit with the same multi-trigger timing as Alternative 4; different interpretations of which time point governs a reported measurement would change limit applicability and whether monitoring was required for that episode.

candidates.exact_span: Alternative 5 - Sewage sludge shall be treated by one of the Processes to Further Reduce Pathogens (PFRP) described in 503 Appendix B. PFRPs include composting, heat drying, heat treatment, and thermophilic aerobic digestion.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Offers a process-based compliance pathway instead of numeric density limits; whether a facility is evaluated under this alternative changes whether numeric exceedance comparisons apply, what monitoring is required, and how absent numeric results are classified.

candidates.exact_span: Alternative 6 - Sewage sludge shall be treated by a process that is equivalent to a Process to Further Reduce Pathogens, if individually approved by the Pathogen Equivalency Committee representing the EPA.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Compliance depends on an equivalency approval condition; whether that approval is established changes which compliance pathway applies, whether numeric limits govern, and whether missing approval evidence leaves applicability unresolved.

candidates.exact_span: Alternatives 2 and 3 are not authorized to demonstrate compliance with Class B sewage sludge in Texas permits.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Excludes two Class B demonstration pathways in Texas; interpreting a facility's claimed compliance alternative changes which numeric limits and monitoring obligations apply and how evidence of process-based compliance is treated.

candidates.exact_span: Alternative 1 - Seven random samples of the sewage sludge shall be collected for one monitoring episode at the time the sewage sludge is used or disposed.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Defines a concrete sampling obligation (seven random samples, one monitoring episode, tied to use/disposal timing); different readings of episode scope or timing would change whether monitoring was required and how missing sample evidence is categorized.

candidates.exact_span: The geometric mean of the density of fecal coliform in the samples collected shall be less than either 2,000,000 MPN per gram of total solids (dry weight basis) or 2,000,000 Colony Forming Units per gram of total solids (dry weight basis).
candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets the enforceable numeric fecal-coliform limit as a geometric mean with two allowable unit bases (MPN vs. CFU); choosing or applying the wrong unit basis to reported measurements would change exceedance determinations.

candidates.exact_span: Alternative 2 - Sewage sludge shall be treated in one of the Processes to significantly Reduce Pathogens described in 503 Appendix B.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Provides a process-based Class B pathway that is unauthorized in Texas; whether this alternative is treated as available affects numeric limit applicability, monitoring requirements, and interpretation of missing numeric results.

candidates.exact_span: Alternative 3 - Sewage sludge shall be treated in a process that is equivalent to a PSRP, if individually approved by the Pathogen Equivalency Committee representing the EPA.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Combines a PSRP-equivalency pathway with an individual-approval condition and Texas non-authorization; interpretation of pathway and approval status changes limit comparisons, monitoring obligations, and unresolved missing-evidence cases.

candidates.computation_change_reason: Makes subsequent harvest-timing obligations conditional on Class B land application; whether land application occurred determines if these requirements were applicable and how periods without related evidence are classified.

candidates.exact_span: Food crops with harvested parts below the surface of the land shall not be harvested for 20 months after application of sewage sludge when the sewage sludge remains on the land surface for 4 months or longer prior to incorporation into the soil.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Imposes a conditional harvest restriction keyed to incorporation timing (≥4 months on surface); interpreting incorporation duration changes which restriction period applies and whether related monitoring or documentation obligations were triggered.

candidates.exact_span: Food crops with harvested parts below the surface of the land shall not be harvested for 38 months after application of sewage sludge when the sewage sludge remains on the land surface for less than 4 months prior to incorporation into the soil.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets a longer harvest restriction when surface retention is under 4 months; boundary interpretation around the 4-month incorporation threshold changes which obligation applies and how missing harvest-timing evidence is resolved.
